description: Compact variable speed drive with Modbus RTU on its RJ45 port
source: Schneider Electric, ATV12 Modbus Communication Manual BBV28590, 06/2012

sources.title: Altivar 12 Modbus Communication Manual
sources.note: Communication parameters, drive state machine, command and status words and the I/O scanner

notes: Partial map: the manual gives the communication settings, the control and status words, the communication scanner and a few examples. The full list of drive parameters is in a separate Excel file that came with the manual and is not mapped here.

Registers are addressed as the W numbers of the manual (W3201 is address 3201; the examples send 16#0C81 for 3201 and 16#2329 for 9001), so address_base is 0. Functions: 0x03 read, 0x06 write one, 0x10 write several, 0x17 read/write (four words each way), 0x2B/0x0E device identification.

Control: write the command word (CMD, 8501) with 6, 7 and then 15 to run and read the status word (ETA, 3201); the state machine follows IEC 61800-7. A masked ETA (ETA and 16#006F) gives the state: 16#0050 switch on disabled, 16#0031 ready, 16#0033 switched on, 16#0037 operation enabled, 16#0017 quick stop active.
Units are given only by the manual's examples (HSP 50 Hz = 500, tFr 60 Hz = 600, SFr 4 kHz = 40, so 0.1 Hz and 0.1 kHz); no scale is set because the manual does not state it in a table.
Serial settings: 4.8, 9.6, 19.2 or 38.4 kbps (default 19.2 kbps on the ATV12), 8E1 by default, address 1 to 247. The factory address is off until set. Address 0 is broadcast and is not answered.
This map covers the ATV12 only; the ATV212 uses a different manual.

registers.name: Status word (ETA)
registers.description: Drive state word; 16#0637 stopped or forward at speed, 16#0237 forward accelerating or decelerating, 16#8237 reverse accelerating or decelerating

registers.name: Command word (CMD)
registers.description: Drive state commands: 6 shutdown, 7 switch on, 15 enable operation, 0 disable voltage, 2 quick stop, 128 fault reset (rising edge). Bit 11 reverse direction, bit 8 stop

registers.name: Speed reference (LFRD)
registers.description: Speed reference written over Modbus

registers.name: Switching frequency (SFr)
registers.description: Example value 40 for 4 kHz

registers.name: Maximum output frequency (tFr)
registers.description: Example value 600 for 60 Hz (0.1 Hz)

registers.name: High speed (HSP)
registers.description: Example value 500 for 50 Hz (0.1 Hz)

registers.name: Low speed (LSP)
registers.description: 0.1 Hz

registers.name: Acceleration time (ACC)
registers.description: The manual's example writes 13 for 13 s

registers.name: Modbus address (Add)
registers.description: 0 = off (broadcast only), 1 to 247

registers.name: Modbus time-out (ttO)
registers.description: 0.1 to 30 s, default 10 s

registers.name: Scanner input 1 source address (nMA1)
registers.description: Address of the parameter read as input word 1

registers.name: Scanner input 2 source address (nMA2)
registers.description: Address of the parameter read as input word 2

registers.description: Address of the parameter read as input word 3

registers.name: Scanner input 4 source address (nMA4)
registers.description: Address of the parameter read as input word 4

registers.name: Scanner output 1 destination address (nCA1)
registers.description: Address of the parameter written as output word 1

registers.description: Address of the parameter written as output word 2
